label: CONFIRMED: TEMPLATE_SOURCE validates marker presence only; the migration contract supports old v2.1 markers indefinitely, and the baseline example fails because a document has no marker.

CONFIRMED: create.sh relocates an existing source marker but returns successfully when it is absent; current-template marker presence is not enforced in that helper and full post-create validation is opt-in.

CONFIRMED: The staleness checker reports markerless documents as none but only auto-upgrades existing stale version comments, so it leaves missing historical provenance unresolved rather than inventing it.

direction: Treat every older template marker version as a validation failure or automatically stamp markerless legacy documents with the current version.
reason: The migration contract accepts old marked versions indefinitely and missing provenance does not establish which template produced a document.
